question_text: A laboratory researcher connects from public Wi-Fi to private lab resources. Outline two reasons for using a correctly configured VPN.
adaptation_rationale: VPN purpose and countermeasure are explicit; avoid source suggestions that VPN provides universal anonymity. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Encrypted tunnel protects traffic from local eavesdroppers; authenticated access allows authorized use of private lab resources over the internet.

marking_points.criterion: Links encryption to confidentiality on untrusted Wi-Fi.
Links access to resources unavailable directly on public internet.
